propositions: Container recreation via autodeploy.sh kills in-flight code reviews before they can vote, causing the LLM-Review gate to live-lock when deploy gaps are shorter than review duration.
The reconciler path awaits review_and_vote outside the shutdown queue, so it is cancelled within 10s during container shutdown while the webhook queue is protected by a 1200s+ drain period.
Health signals remain green (running state, zero VOTER_ERROR, all CloudWatch alarms OK) during a live-locked gate because killed reviews emit no failure markers.
Option DEFER defers the deploy when the bot reports in-flight reviews, keyed to the deferral episode with a 1800s bound to prevent permanent blocking.
Observability is added via AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT counters with a new paging alarm to detect the previously invisible failure mode.
